paragraphs.text: Pentavite is a unique creature subtype for a type of artifact creature which only appears on tokens .
Pentavite debuted as a type in Mirrodin on tokens created by Pentavus . It had its first token card printed as part of Magic Player Rewards in 2004.
An avite is an artifact creature created by one of the 4 "avus" constructs . Other avites are Triskelavites and Tetravites .
